_instructions: List up to 15 locations. For live data use type 'openaq' with the OpenAQ location ID (find IDs by running: python scripts/fetch_pm25.py --discover). For a location with no live data use type 'manual' and fill every field from a source you have checked yourself. Delete the two example entries below before publishing.
